properties.name: WLS LOB Triangulation v1
properties.description: Weighted least-squares procedure for intersecting two or more acoustic line-of-bearing observations into a location estimate. Inputs: lob observations, sensor geometry, correlation window. Outputs: location estimate, residual, contributing sensor set. Assumptions: (1) At least two valid LOBs are required, (2) LOBs must pass staleness and correlation gates, (3) Result quality depends on geometry and bearing uncertainty.
